text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Autumn Shield. What kind of race will 
the Umamusume show us?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
You can truly feel the fiery passion of 
the packed crowd for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Briaaan!! Keep the momentum going 
from the spring!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm rootin' for ya! Give the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) everything you've got, for your 
sister's sake too! Brian-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser! Today you will start 
the race! And cross the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser! Don't let your guard down 
until the very end! You can't get 
scratched from the race, okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-It feels like the cheers for me are 
kinda different from the rest...

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, I just want her to 
finish the race safely!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aha~... I'll do my best.

Matikanetannhauser waves in response to 
the cheers. A gentle ripple of laughter 
fills the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Tch. What's with this laid-back vibe? 
This isn't a grade school sports day."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Are they looking at the runners' eyes...?
choice_data_list: Don't get swept away, stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm going.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, she enters the paddock! It's 
Narita Brian!!
(Wooooaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: O-Ooh... That's a true boss right there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
“Still... U-Umm! I don't plan on just 
going down without a fight!”

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah!? Please don't look at me with such 
a scary face!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"What I just said was purely from the 
bottom of my heart!? I had no intention of 
provoking you whatsoever!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, declaring war on Brian? Don't go 
passing out from nerves now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aha... I'm alright.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Well, the audience must be worried too~ 
Given my history of bungling things when 
it matters most."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I've worked hard too. Every day, 
picturing the face of the rival I want to 
defeat."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I studied your running over and over, 
searching solely for my path to victory.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's only natural, isn't it? 
Tahaha... No way, no way, it's not like I 
could ever compare to Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It reaches me, of course.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Only a handful ever make it to the GⅠ 
level. Even among those with unbreakable 
wills, this stage is reserved strictly for 
the chosen few."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will finish you off with 
every fiber of my being. Victory in this 
race belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Come at me like you mean to crush me 
too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hah... Yes!!
